**Job Description:**
--------------------

### **Position Overview**

* **Job Title:** Kitchen Executive (F&B Production)
* **Department:** Food & Beverage (Culinary / Production)
* **Reports To:** F&B Head/Executive Chef
* **Specialty:** Indian or North Indian cuisine or regional expertise
  

  

**Role Summary:**

  
  

The **kitchen executive** plays a critical role in bridging culinary artistry with kitchen management. You will be responsible for overseeing day-to-day food production, maintaining rigorous quality and hygiene standards, mentoring the kitchen brigade, and assisting management with cost control and menu execution. This role requires a hands-on leader who can maintain composure and efficiency in a high-pressure kitchen environment.

### **Detailed Key Responsibilities**

#### **1. Food Production & Quality Assurance**

* Execute daily food preparation and production following standardized recipes, portion guidelines, and presentation standards.
* Conduct regular quality checks on raw materials, ingredients, and finished dishes to ensure optimal taste, texture, and visual appeal.
* Oversee the setup, organization, and smooth functioning of respective kitchen stations (hot, cold, pastry, or specialized sections) prior to and during service hours.
* Ensure all food items are prepared, cooked, and held at correct temperatures in compliance with food safety protocols.

#### **2. Kitchen Operations & Supervision**

* Supervise, guide, and evaluate line cooks, commis chefs, and kitchen stewards to ensure maximum productivity and teamwork.
* Delegate daily prep lists, cleaning duties, and opening/closing checklists effectively among kitchen staff.
* Monitor kitchen workflow during peak operational hours to minimize ticket times and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Address and resolve any food quality issues or operational delays immediately on the floor.

#### **3. Inventory, Cost & Waste Management**

* Monitor inventory levels of perishable and non-perishable goods, assisting in daily/weekly stock counts and ordering processes.
* Implement and enforce the **FIFO (First-In, First-Out)** method for all inventory to maximize freshness and minimize food spoilage.
* Track and record kitchen wastage, trimmings, and spoilage daily to help management maintain targeted food cost percentages.
* Prevent over-production and optimize ingredient utilization through creative cross-utilization of stocks.

#### **4. Hygiene, Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure strict adherence to **HACCP** guidelines, local health codes, and food safety regulations across all storage, prep, and cooking areas.
* Monitor personal hygiene standards of the kitchen team (proper uniforms, hairnets, handwashing protocols, and gloving).
* Conduct regular safety inspections of kitchen machinery, gas lines, exhaust hoods, and electrical appliances; report technical faults immediately.
* Maintain spotless sanitation of work stations, refrigerators, walk-in chillers, and deep-cleaning schedules.

#### **5. Administration & Menu Development**

* Assist the F&B head in conceptualizing seasonal menus, buffet layouts, and special event catering cards.
* Maintain up-to-date recipe cards, production sheets, and training logs for kitchen staff.
* Participate in periodic kitchen briefings, food tasting sessions, and operational meetings.
* Assist in training new kitchen hires on brand standards, recipe execution, and safety protocols.

### **Qualifications & Requirements**

* **Education:** Diploma or degree in culinary arts, hospitality, or hotel management.
* **Experience:** Minimum **7** **to 8 years** of progressive culinary experience in a reputed hotel, fine-dining establishment, or high-volume catering setup, including at least 1–2 years in a senior or supervisory capacity.
* **Core Competencies:**
  + Advanced knowledge of culinary techniques, kitchen equipment handling, and food science.
  + Strong leadership, delegation, and conflict-resolution skills.
  + Exceptional time management and the ability to work under high-stress conditions.
  + Basic computer literacy (MS Office, inventory management software).
* **Mandatory Certifications:** Valid Food Safety & Hygiene Certification (e.g., HACCP, ServSafe, or local equivalent).
  

  

### **Working Conditions & Physical Demands**

* Ability to work flexible shifts, including early mornings, late nights, weekends, and holidays, or absence of CDPs to support kitchen staff
